description: LinkedIn recruiter jobs feedback broken links: search openkrill MCP tools by task. Use this to find a tool for recruiter search, LinkedIn keywords, jobs, feedback, a missing tool, bug reports, broken links, CVEs, packages, a domain check, or any other task. Lists tool name, a plain task phrase, and the MCP URL to connect. Feedback itself is submit_feedback on this same server.

keyword.description: Alias for query: keyword to search.

query.description: Optional task keyword or phrase to search tools (e.g. 'recruiter', 'linkedin', 'feedback', 'broken links', 'jobs'). Omit to list all tools.

task.description: Alias for query: task phrase to search.

name: index_tools

query.description: The search phrase, when one was given.

task.description: What the tool does, in plain words.

url.description: MCP URL of the server that has the tool.

title: Index and search openkrill MCP tools by task and keyword
